skill.name: directory-submissions
skill.description: Build a prioritized directory submission plan with readiness checks, tailored positioning, launch timing, review outreach, backlink verification, and tracking.
skill.summary: Plan relevant directory submissions and tailored launch campaigns for software products.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All 304 static findings are false positives. Markdown backticks, prose, and catalog URLs do not execute commands or transmit data. However, the skill encourages platform manipulation and backlink spam.

remediation.issue: The Product Hunt playbook encourages authentic-looking account history, coordinated early support, and wording intended to avoid anti-manipulation controls.
remediation.suggestion: Remove evasion and ranking-trigger guidance. Require genuine participation, independent feedback, and compliance with current Product Hunt rules.

remediation.issue: The directory reference promotes profiles and local listings primarily for domain-rating gains, including platforms with weak product relevance.
remediation.suggestion: Limit recommendations to services the product genuinely uses. Remove Pastebin and pure domain-rating tactics, and require original value on content platforms.

content.value_statement: Unfocused directory campaigns waste launch momentum and create weak backlinks. This skill prioritizes suitable directories, prepares tailored positioning, and tracks submissions, reviews, and results.
actual_capabilities: Checks launch readiness across product access, pricing, legal pages, assets, structured data, and destination pages.
Selects directory tiers for SaaS, AI, MCP, no-code, integrations, reviews, and niche products.
Creates distinct taglines and descriptions for each directory audience.
Builds a three-week Product Hunt preparation and launch schedule.
Plans G2, Capterra, and TrustRadius review outreach using the 10-in-30 framework.
Provides a CSV tracker with directory URLs, status fields, positioning variants, and backlink verification fields.
limitations: Directory URLs, domain ratings, fees, and platform rules can change and require manual verification.
The skill does not submit forms, create accounts, upload assets, or guarantee directory approval.
Backlinks and directory traffic do not guarantee rankings, citations, leads, or sales.
Product Hunt and review tactics must follow each platform's current policies.

use_cases.title: Launch a New SaaS Product
use_cases.description: Assess launch readiness, prioritize directories, and schedule submissions around Product Hunt and review campaigns.
use_cases.target_user: Startup founders preparing a public launch

use_cases.title: Organize an Ongoing Backlink Campaign
use_cases.description: Select relevant directories, vary positioning, record approvals, and verify live backlinks without relying on bulk submission services.

use_cases.title: Promote an AI or MCP Product
use_cases.description: Identify AI directories and MCP registries, then prepare technical descriptions that match each audience.
use_cases.target_user: Developer marketers launching AI tools or MCP servers

prompt_templates.title: Assess Launch Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess our directory readiness. Product: [name and URL]. Launch date: [date]. Assets available: [list]. Identify blockers before suggesting directories.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a focused readiness review.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Directory Tiers
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-week directory plan for [product]. Audience: [audience]. Category: [SaaS, AI, MCP, no-code, or other]. Prioritize suitable tiers and explain exclusions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn basic product context into a submission sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Write Positioning Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Write distinct directory copy for [product]. Include a tagline, short description, and longer description for startup, SaaS, AI, and review platforms. Use only verified claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare audience-specific copy after selecting directories.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete Launch Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an advanced launch and measurement plan for [product] launching on [date]. Include Product Hunt preparation, review outreach, weekly targets, and tracker fields. Flag policy risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate submissions, reviews, launch timing, and measurement.

output_examples.input: We launch an AI meeting assistant in three weeks. We have a website but no pricing page or screenshots.
output: Readiness: Blocked until pricing, privacy, terms, screenshots, three alternative pages, and three use-case pages are live.
Priority: Product Hunt, BetaList, selected SaaS directories, and AI directories after readiness work.
MCP registries apply only if the product exposes a working MCP server.

output_examples.input: Create positioning for a privacy-focused analytics product that competes with Google Analytics.
output: Startup tagline: Privacy-first analytics without complex setup.
SaaS framing: A lightweight Google Analytics alternative for teams that need clear metrics without invasive tracking.
Review framing: Helps small teams understand acquisition performance while reducing setup time and privacy risk.

output_examples.input: We submitted to 50 directories last week. What should we do next?
output: Verify each live backlink and record whether it is dofollow, nofollow, or missing.
Build alternative, use-case, template, and integration pages that can convert referral traffic.
Track referring domains, indexed pages, organic clicks, directory referrals, and signups each week.

best_practices: Verify each directory's current submission rules, pricing, backlink behavior, and audience fit before submitting.
Use accurate product claims and distinct positioning for each directory type.
Record submission dates, live URLs, review status, and measurable outcomes in the tracker.
anti_patterns: Do not submit to irrelevant directories only for domain-rating gains.
Do not copy identical descriptions across directories or fabricate product claims.
Do not coordinate votes, disguise promotional activity, or evade platform moderation controls.

faq.question: Does this skill submit listings automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates plans, copy, schedules, and tracking guidance. Users must review and submit each listing.

faq.question: Which products can use this skill?
faq.answer: It supports SaaS, AI tools, MCP servers, no-code products, developer tools, integrations, and suitable niche products.

faq.question: Can it plan a Product Hunt launch?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides a three-week preparation schedule, asset checklist, launch-day tasks, and post-launch follow-up.

faq.question: Does it guarantee backlinks or search rankings?
faq.answer: No. Directory acceptance, backlink attributes, rankings, traffic, and conversions depend on external platforms and product quality.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the product URL, category, audience, launch date, assets, integrations, destination pages, review capacity, and current acquisition metrics.

faq.question: How current is the directory data?
faq.answer: The included list is a planning reference. Verify every URL, fee, policy, domain rating, and backlink attribute before submission.
